description: This file defines a FixturePool class and related types and functions for managing test fixtures in a testing framework, including fixture registration, dependency validation, and error handling.

classes.name: FixturePool
classes.description: Manages registration, validation, and resolution of test fixtures, including dependency cycle detection and error reporting.

methods.name: isFixtureTuple
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a FixtureTuple.

methods.name: isFixtureOption
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a FixtureTuple with an 'option' property.

methods.name: fixtureParameterNames
methods.description: Extracts fixture parameter names from a function, caching the result.

methods.name: inheritFixtureNames
methods.description: Copies fixture parameter names from one function to another.

methods.name: innerFixtureParameterNames
methods.description: Parses function source code to extract fixture parameter names, ignoring comments.

methods.name: filterOutComments
methods.description: Removes comments from source code string.

methods.name: splitByComma
methods.description: Splits a string by commas, respecting nested brackets.

methods.name: registrationId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a unique ID for a fixture registration.
